verdict.rationale: Insomnia is an API client with cloud sync, collection runs and mock servers, so emitting outbound webhooks for events is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. Mock servers, request chaining, scripting and the Inso CLI are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
